verdict.rationale: The skills are SKILL.md folders installable through the open `skills` CLI into several agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), and the repo ships portable Hermes/Agent Plugins metadata alongside Cursor metadata. That shows real cross-vendor portability, but nothing explicitly states conformance to the open Agent Skills specification. missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, spec-level validation (validate.mjs checks only internal contracts), independent confirmation that the folders work unchanged in non-YYLO tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling

citations.quote: Install interactively with the open `skills` CLI
Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
portable Hermes/Agent Plugins metadata lives in root `plugin.json`
